<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Emotionsparty · Recreación infantil y para adultos</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@500;600;700&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --night:#3A1C63;
    --night-2:#2A1448;
    --ink:#2A1448;
    --paper:#FDF6EC;
    --paper-2:#FFFFFF;
    --kids-pink:#FB4970;
    --kids-yellow:#FFD866;
    --adult-teal:#3ECAC2;
    --adult-violet:#8B5CF6;
    --kids-orange:#FF9142;
    --line: rgba(42,20,72,0.12);
    --line-light: rgba(253,246,236,0.16);
    --wa:#25D366;
    --shadow: 0 20px 40px -20px rgba(42,20,72,0.35);
    --radius: 22px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:'Manrope', sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink);
    background:var(--paper);
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,.display{
    font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    line-height:1.05;
    margin:0;
  }
  p{margin:0;}
  a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
  ul{margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
  .wrap{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:0 28px;
  }
  section{position:relative;}

  /* ---------- Reduced motion ---------- */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{animation:none !important; transition:none !important;}
  }

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header.site{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:60;
    background:rgba(253,246,236,0.86);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:16px 28px;
    max-width:1180px; margin:0 auto;
  }
  .logo{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size:1.35rem; font-weight:700;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .logo-img{
    height:44px; width:auto;
    border-radius:10px;
    display:block;
  }
  .logo-dot{
    width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%;
    background:conic-gradient(from 90deg, var(--kids-pink), var(--kids-yellow), var(--adult-teal), var(--adult-violet), var(--kids-pink));
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .nav-links{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:30px;
    font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem;
  }
  .nav-links a{opacity:0.75; transition:opacity .2s;}
  .nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a:focus-visible{opacity:1;}
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    padding:12px 22px;
    border-radius:999px;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:0.92rem;
    border:none;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  }
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .btn:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible{
    outline:3px solid var(--adult-violet);
    outline-offset:3px;
  }
  .btn-wa{
    background:var(--wa);
    color:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 12px 24px -10px rgba(37,211,102,0.55);
  }
  .btn-ghost{
    background:transparent;
    border:2px solid var(--ink);
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .nav .btn-wa{padding:10px 18px; font-size:0.85rem;}
  .burger{display:none;}

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero{
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 14% 18%, rgba(251,73,112,0.32), transparent 42%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 86% 12%, rgba(139,92,246,0.4), transparent 40%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 78% 82%, rgba(62,202,194,0.28), transparent 45%),
      var(--night);
    color:var(--paper);
    padding:96px 0 120px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero::before, .hero::after{
    content:"★";
    position:absolute;
    font-size:1.6rem;
    color:var(--kids-yellow);
    opacity:0.8;
  }
  .hero::before{ top:8%; left:8%; transform:rotate(-12deg); }
  .hero::after{ top:14%; right:38%; color:var(--kids-pink); font-size:1.1rem; transform:rotate(15deg); }
  .hero-inner{
    max-width:1180px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 28px;
    display:block;
  }
  .hero-inner > div:first-child{
    max-width:680px; margin:0 auto; text-align:center;
  }
  .hero-ctas, .hero-stats{justify-content:center;}
  .hero p.lead{margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;}
  .hero-stats div{text-align:left;}
  .eyebrow{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    font-size:0.82rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--kids-yellow);
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(2.6rem, 5vw, 4.1rem);
    color:#fff;
    margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .hero h1 span{
    background:linear-gradient(92deg, var(--kids-pink), var(--kids-yellow) 45%, var(--adult-teal) 75%, var(--adult-violet));
    -webkit-background-clip:text;
    background-clip:text;
    color:transparent;
  }
  .tagline-pill{
    display:inline-block;
    background:var(--kids-pink);
    color:#fff;
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:0.95rem;
    padding:11px 26px;
    border-radius:999px;
    margin-bottom:22px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -10px rgba(251,73,112,0.5);
  }
  .hero p.lead{
    font-size:1.15rem;
    line-height:1.6;
    color:rgba(253,246,236,0.82);
    max-width:46ch;
    margin-bottom:34px;
  }
  .hero-ctas{display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .btn-light{
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--night);
  }
  .hero-stats{
    display:flex; gap:28px; margin-top:52px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .hero-stats div{border-left:2px solid var(--line-light); padding-left:14px;}
  .hero-stats b{display:block; font-family:'Fredoka'; font-size:1.6rem; color:#fff;}
  .hero-stats span{font-size:0.82rem; color:rgba(253,246,236,0.65);}

  /* ---------- EMOTION DIVIDER (signature element) ---------- */
  .emo-divider{
    background:var(--paper);
    padding:34px 0;
    overflow-x:auto;
  }
  .emo-track{
    display:flex; gap:34px; justify-content:center; align-items:center;
    min-width:max-content; margin:0 auto; padding:0 28px;
  }
  .emo-item{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); opacity:0.7;}
  .emo-dot{width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%;}
  .emo-item:nth-child(1) .emo-dot{background:var(--kids-pink);}
  .emo-item:nth-child(2) .emo-dot{background:var(--kids-yellow);}
  .emo-item:nth-child(3) .emo-dot{background:var(--adult-teal);}
  .emo-item:nth-child(4) .emo-dot{background:var(--adult-violet);}
  .emo-item:nth-child(5) .emo-dot{background:#FF8A5B;}

  /* ---------- SECTION HEADS ---------- */
  .section-head{
    max-width:640px; margin:0 auto 52px; text-align:center;
  }
  .section-head .tag{
    display:inline-block; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:0.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:999px;
    margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem);}
  .section-head p{margin-top:14px; font-size:1.05rem; line-height:1.6; opacity:0.75;}

  /* ---------- SERVICES ---------- */
  .services{padding:96px 0;}
  .services.kids{background:var(--paper);}
  .services.adults{background:var(--night); color:var(--paper);}
  .services.adults .section-head p{color:rgba(253,246,236,0.72);}
  .tag.kids-tag{background:rgba(255,93,143,0.15); color:#D93866;}
  .tag.adults-tag{background:rgba(123,97,255,0.2); color:#B7ACFF;}

  .card-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:22px;
  }
  .card-grid-4{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr);
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .card-grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  }
  .card{
    background:var(--paper-2);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:30px 26px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    transition: transform .22s ease;
  }
  .card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);}
  .services.adults .card{
    background:rgba(253,246,236,0.06);
    border:1px solid var(--line-light);
    box-shadow:none;
  }
  .card-icon{
    width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:16px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    margin-bottom:18px;
    font-size:1.5rem;
  }
  .kids .card:nth-child(6n+1) .card-icon, .kids .card:nth-child(6n+1){--accent:var(--kids-pink);}
  .card h3{font-size:1.15rem; margin-bottom:10px; font-weight:600;}
  .card p{font-size:0.92rem; line-height:1.55; opacity:0.75;}
  .kids .card-icon{background:rgba(255,93,143,0.12); color:#D93866;}
  .kids .card:nth-child(3n+2) .card-icon{background:rgba(255,193,69,0.18); color:#B4790A;}
  .kids .card:nth-child(3n) .card-icon{background:rgba(46,196,182,0.14); color:#1A8F84;}
  .adults .card-icon{background:rgba(123,97,255,0.18); color:#C9BFFF;}
  .adults .card:nth-child(3n+2) .card-icon{background:rgba(46,196,182,0.16); color:#8FE9E0;}
  .adults .card:nth-child(3n) .card-icon{background:rgba(255,193,69,0.15); color:#FFD98A;}

  .btn-see-package{
    margin-top:22px;
    background:var(--kids-pink);
    color:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 12px 24px -10px rgba(251,73,112,0.5);
  }
  .card-clickable{cursor:pointer;}

  /* ---------- MODAL / POP-UP ---------- */
  .modal-overlay{
    display:none;
    position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100;
    background:rgba(20,10,35,0.72);
    backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
    align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    padding:24px;
  }
  .modal-overlay.open{display:flex;}
  .modal-box{
    position:relative;
    max-width:420px; width:100%;
    max-height:90vh;
    border-radius:20px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    background:var(--paper-2);
  }
  .modal-img{
    width:100%; height:100%;
    max-height:90vh;
    object-fit:contain;
    display:block;
  }
  .modal-close{
    position:absolute; top:10px; right:10px;
    width:38px; height:38px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(20,10,35,0.6);
    color:#fff;
    border:none;
    font-size:1.5rem;
    line-height:1;
    cursor:pointer;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .modal-close:hover{background:rgba(20,10,35,0.85);}

  /* ---------- TESTIMONIALS ---------- */
  .testimonials{padding:96px 0; background:var(--paper);}

  .ig-gallery{
    margin-top:10px;
  }
  .ig-gallery-label{
    text-align:center;
    font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:1.25rem;
    color:var(--ink);
    margin-bottom:28px;
  }
  .t-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:22px;
  }
  .t-card{
    background:var(--paper-2);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:28px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .stars{color:var(--kids-yellow); font-size:1rem; margin-bottom:14px; letter-spacing:2px;}
  .t-card p.quote{font-size:0.98rem; line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:20px;}
  .t-person{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;}
  .t-avatar{
    width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:50%;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-family:'Fredoka'; font-weight:600; color:#fff; font-size:0.95rem;
  }
  .t-person b{display:block; font-size:0.9rem;}
  .t-person span{display:block; font-size:0.78rem; opacity:0.6;}

  /* ---------- SOCIAL ---------- */
  .social{
    padding:90px 0;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--night), var(--kids-pink) 130%);
    color:#fff;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .social h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.4vw,2.5rem); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .social p{opacity:0.92; max-width:520px; margin:0 auto 36px; line-height:1.6;}
  .social-links{
    display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .social-pill{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    padding:13px 24px;
    border-radius:999px;
    font-weight:700; font-size:0.92rem;
    transition: background .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  }
  .social-pill:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.26); transform:translateY(-3px);}
  .social-pill svg{width:18px; height:18px;}

  /* ---------- FINAL CTA ---------- */
  .final-cta{
    background:var(--night);
    color:var(--paper);
    padding:100px 0;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .final-cta h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,2.9rem); margin-bottom:18px;}
  .final-cta p{opacity:0.75; max-width:480px; margin:0 auto 34px; line-height:1.6; font-size:1.05rem;}

  /* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
  footer{
    background:var(--ink);
    color:rgba(253,246,236,0.65);
    padding:48px 0 30px;
    font-size:0.85rem;
  }
  .footer-inner{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:18px;
  }
  .footer-inner .logo{color:var(--paper);}

  /* ---------- FLOATING WHATSAPP ---------- */
  .wa-float{
    position:fixed; right:22px; bottom:22px; z-index:80;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    background:var(--wa);
    color:#fff;
    padding:14px 20px 14px 14px;
    border-radius:999px;
    box-shadow:0 16px 30px -10px rgba(37,211,102,0.6);
    font-weight:700; font-size:0.92rem;
  }
  .wa-float svg{width:24px; height:24px;}
  .wa-float:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);}

  /* ---------- MOBILE ---------- */
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .card-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
    .t-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }
  @media (max-width:640px){
    .nav-links{display:none;}
    .card-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .hero{padding:70px 0 90px;}
    .wa-float span{display:none;}
    .wa-float{padding:14px; border-radius:50%;}
    .footer-inner{flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="site">
  <nav class="nav">
    <div class="logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Emotionsparty" class="logo-img"></div>
    <div class="nav-links">
      <a href="#infantil">Infantil</a>
      <a href="#adultos">Adultos</a>
      <a href="#testimonios">Testimonios</a>
      <a href="#redes">Redes</a>
    </div>
    <a class="btn btn-wa" href="https://wa.me/573000000000?text=Hola%20Emotionsparty%2C%20quiero%20cotizar%20un%20evento" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      WhatsApp
    </a>
  </nav>
</header>

<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <div>
      <span class="eyebrow">● Recreación con propósito</span>
      <h1>Convertimos cualquier evento en <span>una emoción que se recuerda</span></h1>
      <p class="tagline-pill">¡Pura diversión en familia!</p>
      <p class="lead">En Emotionsparty diseñamos experiencias de recreación para fiestas infantiles y para eventos de adultos: cumpleaños, integraciones empresariales, bodas y celebraciones donde la diversión es el protagonista.</p>
      <div class="hero-ctas">
        <a class="btn btn-light" href="#infantil">Ver servicios</a>
        <a class="btn btn-wa" href="https://wa.me/573000000000?text=Hola%20Emotionsparty%2C%20quiero%20cotizar%20un%20evento" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Escríbenos por WhatsApp</a>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-stats">
        <div><b>+300</b><span>eventos realizados</span></div>
        <div><b>2</b><span>líneas: infantil y adultos</span></div>
        <div><b>100%</b><span>a la medida del evento</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="emo-divider">
  <div class="emo-track">
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Alegría</div>
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Sorpresa</div>
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Complicidad</div>
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Diversión</div>
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Nostalgia</div>
  </div>
</div>

<section class="services kids" id="infantil">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="tag kids-tag">Línea infantil</span>
      <h2>Recreación para que los más pequeños no paren de reír</h2>
      <p>Personajes, juegos dirigidos y actividades pensadas por edades para que cada niño y niña sea parte de la fiesta, no solo espectador.</p>
      <button class="btn btn-see-package" onclick="openKidsModal()">Ver paquete y precios</button>
    </div>
    <div class="card-grid card-grid-4">
      <div class="card card-clickable" onclick="openKidsModal()"><div class="card-icon">🎈</div><h3>Recreación con personajes</h3><p>Animación temática con personajes en vivo, juegos grupales y coreografías adaptadas a la edad de los invitados.</p></div>
      <div class="card card-clickable" onclick="openKidsModal()"><div class="card-icon">🎨</div><h3>Pintacaritas y manualidades</h3><p>Estación de pintacaritas y manualidades para que cada niño se lleve un recuerdo propio de la fiesta.</p></div>
      <div class="card card-clickable" onclick="openKidsModal()"><div class="card-icon">🎧</div><h3>Recreación y miniteka</h3><p>Recreación dirigida con música, luces y sonido incluidos para que la pista no pare de bailar.</p></div>
      <div class="card card-clickable" onclick="openKidsModal()"><div class="card-icon">🎭</div><h3>Show de títeres</h3><p>Presentación de títeres en vivo con historias y personajes que atrapan la atención de los más pequeños.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="kidsModal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeKidsModal()">
  <div class="modal-box">
    <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeKidsModal()" aria-label="Cerrar">&times;</button>
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Paquete Emotions Kids - recreación infantil" class="modal-img">
  </div>
</div>


<section class="services adults" id="adultos">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="tag adults-tag">Línea adultos</span>
      <h2>Celebraciones que también se disfrutan en grande</h2>
      <p>Recreación y animación para los momentos importantes de la vida: desde la llegada del bebé hasta la fiesta con amigas.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card-grid card-grid-4">
      <div class="card"><div class="card-icon">🍼</div><h3>Babyshower</h3><p>Recreación y juegos temáticos para celebrar la llegada del bebé con toda la familia y amigos.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="card-icon">💍</div><h3>Bodas y quince años</h3><p>Animación de pista, dinámicas y momentos especiales para que la celebración fluya de principio a fin.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="card-icon">🎱</div><h3>Bingos</h3><p>Jornadas de bingo con animación en vivo, premios y dinámicas para todas las edades.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="card-icon">💃</div><h3>Rumba terapia</h3><p>Sesión de baile y activación física guiada, ideal para despedidas, cumpleaños y jornadas de bienestar.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="emo-divider">
  <div class="emo-track">
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Emoción</div>
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Confianza</div>
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Risa</div>
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Asombro</div>
    <div class="emo-item"><span class="emo-dot"></span>Gratitud</div>
  </div>
</div>

<section class="testimonials" id="testimonios">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head">
      <h2>Historias de quienes ya vivieron una Emotionsparty</h2>
    </div>

    <div class="ig-gallery">
      <!-- Elfsight Instagram Feed | Untitled Instagram Feed -->
      <script src="https://elfsightcdn.com/platform.js" async></script>
      <div class="elfsight-app-41b4d9d5-97bd-4196-882a-597c29398def" data-elfsight-app-lazy></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="social" id="redes">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Síguenos para ver la fiesta por dentro</h2>
    <p>Fotos, videos y detrás de cámaras de cada evento en nuestras redes sociales.</p>
    <div class="social-links">
      <a class="social-pill" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
